title: Budget for hydronium
statement:
How many valence electrons are in H₃O⁺?

[_]{a}

explanations: The charge is used with the wrong sign.
This counts only the three bond pairs.

hints: Add six from oxygen and one from each hydrogen.
Three bonds and one lone pair account for the result.
solution: Add six from oxygen and one from each hydrogen. The +1 charge removes one. Three bonds and one lone pair account for the result. 6+3−1=8.
